siteObservation.finding: The observed /request-pilot/ page carries one h1 ('Talk to the team directly') and an email action; /request-pilot/received/ has one h2 ('What happens next'); /faq/ answers 'How do I actually start working with ShortsOS?' in one line. No observed page says who does what during a pilot or what a pilot does not include.
